pairs.subject: telemetry-pii-redaction
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/useScanTab.ts:124 The context only sends data to the app's own local relative API routes (module-scan import GET/PATCH), and its 'telemetry' is a local genre-pattern scan of the UE project. I searched both directories for sentry, beforeSend, redact, scrub and sendDefaultPii and got no hits. package.json has no hosted error-tracker or analytics client either, and src/lib/logger.ts has no fetch/http/send transport. So no record here passes to an outside custodian, which is the subject's precondition.
